# Oozer

Internal ID: BlobElite | Faction: Undead | Main biome: Swamp | Drops: Ooze | Scrap iron | Abilities: Area of effect | Weak to (x1.5): Blunt, ,, Frost, ,, Lightning | Neutral to (x1): Spirit | Resistant to (x0.5): Fire, ,, Pierce, ,, Slash | Immune to (x0): Poison, ,, Stagger, ,, Chop, ,, Pickaxe

# Introduction

Oozers are aggressive creatures found in Swamps. They are large, gelatinous piles of sentient ooze that emit poisonous yellow gasses. Upon death, they split into two Blobs.

### Drops

• Item: Blob | 0 Star: 2

• Item: Ooze | 0 Star: 2

• Item: Scrap iron | 0 Star: 33%

### Spawning

• Type: Anywhere in Swamp during the nighttime, despawn at dawn | Limit: 1 | Frequency: Common | Stars: No

• Type: Rare spawn point in front of Sunken Crypts, doesn't despawn at dawn | Limit: - | Frequency: One time | Stars: No

• Type: During "A foul smell from the swamp" event after defeating Bonemass | Limit: 2 | Frequency: Very common | Stars: No

• Type: When a Blob bomb Elite poison is used | Limit: - | Frequency: - | Stars: No

### Area of effect

Oozers will stretch slightly before compressing and releasing a cloud of poisonous gas 8 meters in radius, applying the Poison status (115 Poison damage). Despite visual appearances, the cloud does not actually persist and only hits once. This ability can be used when a player is within 3 meters, and it has a cooldown of 4 seconds.

## Notes

• Oozers have a chance to drop Scrap iron, meaning they can theoretically provide early access to Iron equipment before the player obtains a Swamp key. However, given the relatively uncommon spawn rate for Oozers, low drop rate of Scrap iron, and high metal cost of iron equipment, this is generally not a viable strategy for obtaining Iron.
• Oozers have no associated trophy.
